description.en: The name of the application federated identity credential.
The type of the application federated identity credential.

description.zh: OIDC结构化配置（structured模式 + oidc类型）
description.en: The OIDC structured configuration. This parameter applies when the verification mode is structured and the credential type is oidc.

description.zh: PKCS#7结构化配置（structured模式 + pkcs7类型）
description.en: The PKCS#7 structured configuration. This parameter applies when the verification mode is structured and the credential type is pkcs7.

The verification mode. Valid values:

- freedom (default)
- structured

title.en: Create an application federated identity credential

example.unifiedCli: aliyun eiam create-application-federated-credential --instance-id idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk267xxxxx --application-id app_mkv7rgt4d7i4u7zqtzev2mxxxx --federated-credential-provider-id fcp_adasd --application-federated-credential-type oidc --application-federated-credential-name example_name --verification-condition IsNullOrEmpty_jwt.issuer --description description_text --attribute-mappings SourceValueExpression=Append_client.applicationFederatedCredentialId,_:_,_cert.subject.CN,_:_,_cert.serialNumber TargetField=client.activeSubjectUrn --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun eiam CreateApplicationFederatedCredential --region cn-hangzhou --OidcVerificationConfig.GcpVmConfig.ProjectId 'example-string' --Description description_text --OidcVerificationConfig.AzureVmConfig.VmNames.1 'example-string' --InstanceId idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk267xxxxx --ApplicationFederatedCredentialType oidc --OidcVerificationConfig.GcpVmConfig.InstanceIds.1 'example-string' --OidcVerificationConfig.Profile kubernetes --VerificationCondition 'IsNullOrEmpty_jwt.issuer' --OidcVerificationConfig.KubernetesConfig.Namespace default --ApplicationFederatedCredentialName example_name --OidcVerificationConfig.KubernetesConfig.ServiceAccountName 'my-sa' --OidcVerificationConfig.AzureVmConfig.SubscriptionId 'example-string' --OidcVerificationConfig.KubernetesConfig.PodNamePrefix 'my-pod-' --VerificationMode freedom --OidcVerificationConfig.GcpVmConfig.ServiceAccountId 123456789 --Pkcs7VerificationConfig.InstanceIds.1 'example-string' --AttributeMappings.1.SourceValueExpression 'Append_client.applicationFederatedCredentialId,_:_,_cert.subject.CN,_:_,_cert.serialNumber' --AttributeMappings.1.TargetField 'client.activeSubjectUrn' --OidcVerificationConfig.AzureVmConfig.PrincipalId 'example-string' --OidcVerificationConfig.GenericConfig.Subject 'example-string' --ApplicationId app_mkv7rgt4d7i4u7zqtzev2mxxxx --OidcVerificationConfig.AzureVmConfig.ResourceGroupName 'example-string' --FederatedCredentialProviderId fcp_adasd --method POST --force
